# AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 (FSR 1)

Vendored unmodified from the official repository, for the Direct3D renderer's
"高画質" upscaling (EASU upscale + RCAS sharpen).

- Source: https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR
- Commit: a21ffb8f6c13 (2021-11-15, the final FSR 1.0 release)
- Files: `ffx-fsr/ffx_a.h`, `ffx-fsr/ffx_fsr1.h`, `license.txt`
- License: MIT (see `license.txt`) — keep the notice with any copy.

Do not edit these files; put YuCap-specific shader code elsewhere so the
vendored copy can be compared against upstream.
